Name: Prepare for New Day
Author: igotnousername
Description:
Cook your breakfast, iron your clothes, watch the news .....[size=4] [color=#dbb0a7][b]and move your bed away from the door![/b][/color][/size]

You don't need to rush going outside since time will only start once you leave the house, and stops when you're at home after 1:00 am.


[color=#c9daf8][b][size=5]Details:[/size][/b][/color]
Time will stop once you wake up, and will start when you exit the house.
Time will once again stop when you are inside the house after 1:00 am.


[b][color=#c9daf8][size=5]Required:[/size][/color][/b]
1. SMAPI 3.8.0 or later
[color=#ea9999][b]

Note:[/b][/color]
If you want time to always stop when you're at the house, just set the cutOffTime to 600.
